en: Black‑and‑white view taken through tall conifer trees over a small town in a forested mountain valley. In the middle distance stands a church with a square tower and bulbous dome roof, surrounded by dense evergreen woods. Closer to the foreground are several multi‑storey buildings with steep, hipped roofs and large windows, typical of early‑20th‑century Central European alpine or spa architecture. Forested hills rise in the background, giving a secluded mountain‑resort atmosphere. No visible printed caption or border text appears on the image side.
